newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN SUGAR CRUSH - WEEK TO AUG 9.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN SUGAR CRUSH - WEEK TO AUG 9.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 1,818,513 tonnes in the week ended August 9, bringing the crush so far this season to 12.59 million tonnes, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.

This was less than the 12.84 million tonnes crushed at the same time last year. CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week 10 of the 1997 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content was 13.73 percent.
The figures do not include cane crushed in the Ord River region of Western Australia.
